base_info.description: Percentage averaged over 250 m grid cells with centres within 1 km great-circle distance of the site, divided by 100. Water grid cells count as non-vegetated. Sites north of 60 N with grid cells reported as 100 % non-vegetated are NaN, a MOD44B v061 artefact. Representative of 2010.

treeFrac.nameLong: tree cover fraction from MODIS VCF MOD44B v061, mean within 1 km

nontreeFrac.nameLong: non-tree vegetation cover fraction from MODIS VCF MOD44B v061, mean within 1 km

bareFrac.nameLong: bare cover fraction from MODIS VCF MOD44B v061, mean within 1 km

vegFrac.nameLong: vegetation cover fraction from MODIS VCF MOD44B v061, mean within 1 km

treeFrac_merged.nameLong: Tree fraction, in situ where available else MODIS VCF MOD44B v061
treeFrac_merged.sourceDataProductName: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv and MODIS VCF MOD44B v061
treeFrac_merged.description: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv frac_overstory for forest and savanna PFTs and 0 for other PFTs in the csv, otherwise the product tree fraction, capped at the merged vegetation fraction

vegFrac_merged.nameLong: Vegetation fraction, in situ where available else MODIS VCF MOD44B v061
vegFrac_merged.sourceDataProductName: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv and MODIS VCF MOD44B v061
vegFrac_merged.description: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv as 1 - frac_soil, or overstory + understory without soil, averaged over rows of a site, otherwise the product vegetation fraction
